name: lvx_object_delete

provenance.source: Exact xiaomi-band-11-4.100.139 IDB: lv_obj_delete: sets the deleting flag (+51 & 0x10), sends LV_EVENT_DELETE (36), deletes the children recursively, unlinks the object from its parent or screen list and frees it. lv_obj_clean (0xc384db4) calls it per child.

notes: Address corrected by EVID-UI-4139-MSGBOX-001; the earlier CANDIDATE address was a different function. Target-private UI host use only; device probe pending.
